title: Jais 13B open-source release
summary: Inception announced the open-source release of Jais, a 13-billion-parameter Arabic-English large language model, on August 30, 2023. The model was developed in collaboration with Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence and Cerebras Systems and trained on the Condor Galaxy 1 supercomputer.
significance: A primary-source-documented release milestone for an Arabic-centric open large language model, recorded as an open-source release event rather than as an invention, development-start, first-of-kind, or universal-priority claim.
organizations: Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence

verification.note: MBZUAI's August 30, 2023 institutional announcement explicitly records the open-source release of Jais, identifies it as a 13-billion-parameter Arabic-English large language model, names the Inception-MBZUAI-Cerebras collaboration, and states that it was trained on Condor Galaxy 1. G42's institutional release page independently corroborates the open-source release, model scale, collaboration, and training system. The day-precision date is attached only to the public release announcement. No invention date, development-start date, universal priority, ancestry, influence, causality, or relationship edge is inferred.
